dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-web-file-preview is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Preview conversation file links in the web UI (images / text / Markdown / highlighted code / git diff) — click a link to open a preview modal instead of the desktop opener; loopback-fenced routes with weak ETag/304 caching and DOMPurify sanitization.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b3fbabe978f193925ca4.html
